sample_unit: ChatGPT responses to common SCI questions

links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT spinal cord injury answers (Flesch-Kincaid grade level and reading ease)
links.effect: Flesch-Kincaid reading ease 26.24 ± 13.81; grade level 14.84 ± 1.79, requiring about 14 to 15 years of formal education; mean EQIP score 43.02 ± 6.37.
links.quote: The Flesch-Kincaid grade level indicated a high linguistic complexity, requiring a level of education equivalent to approximately 14 to 15 years of formal education for comprehension.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT's responses to spinal cord injury queries regarding information quality and readability, but without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
